name: streampay
description: Workspace-level scripts exposing every workflow step for contributors.

scripts.test:fuzz: echo 'Run fuzz targets manually: cd fuzz && cargo +nightly fuzz run <target>'
scripts.build: npm run build:contract && npm run build:frontend
scripts.matrix: npm run codes:check && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build:contract && npm run build:frontend && npm run typecheck && npm run audit && npm run generated:check && npm run ci:sdk && npm run ci:react && npm run theme:check && npm run eol:check && npm run links:check && npm run dashboard:check && npm run json:check
scripts.ci:contract: npm run codes:check && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build:contract && npm run generated:surface
scripts.ci:sdk: npm run test:sdk:generator && npm run sdk:check && npm run test:sdk:python && npm run typecheck --workspace @streampay/sdk && npm test --workspace @streampay/sdk
scripts.ci:react: npm run build --workspace @streampay/sdk && npm run typecheck --workspace @streampay/react && npm test --workspace @streampay/react && npm run build --workspace @streampay/react && npm run build-storybook --workspace @streampay/react
scripts.ci:frontend: npm run build:frontend && npm run typecheck && npm run audit && npm run theme:check
scripts.theme:check: npm --prefix frontend run test:contrast:self-test && npm --prefix frontend run test:contrast && npm --prefix frontend run test:theme-colors:self-test && npm --prefix frontend run test:theme
